Name: Water Bubble
Effect: Reduce by 1 the total damage dealt to this Pokémon by Fire-Type Moves. Burn (1) and Burn (2) deal no Damage to this Pokémon. Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Pokémon's Water-Type Moves.
Description: The Pokémon is shielded by a water bubble. Strangely, the bubble is filled with clear water inside instead of air.
